pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin at the top-left image corner; all values in pixels

camera.motion: static: phase correlation of the ground region vs frame 0 gives 0.00 px shift in every frame; the only pixel changes are the missile plus faint launch-flash lighting near the pod (frames 2-13)

perspective_cues.horizon: hidden by a hill; ridge peak at about (930, 535); far ground/sky edge at y about 615 (x=0) to 665 (x=1920); true horizon probably near y 560-620 (camera roughly level, slightly upward because the sky fills the top half)
perspective_cues.ground: sandy desert sloping up to the hill; a pale dirt track runs from bottom centre (~x 900, y 1080) toward the right edge (~x 1920, y 905) behind the truck
perspective_cues.missile_apparent_size: apparent length grows 145 px (f13) -> 213 px (f30), width 13.2 -> 15.4 px: the missile gets somewhat nearer to the camera as it climbs and/or turns more side-on; part of the length growth is motion blur (blur streak along the axis grows with speed: 30 -> 61 px/frame image speed). Width (blur-free) suggests about +15% scale change f15->f30.

camera.focal_length: unknown (estimate from given depth_info + a known size)

objects.name: missile
objects.description: slender tan/brown rocket with pointed nose, launched from the rear-launcher pod of the truck, flies up and to the left in a straight image line and leaves the frame at the top edge near x 650
objects.visible_frames: nose first visible frame 3 (only nose tip outside the tube until frame 12); fully visible frames 13-30; clipped by top edge frames 31-33; gone frame 34. In frames 0-2 it is inside its tube (not visible).

apparent_length_px.note: includes motion blur along the axis

objects.name: launcher_truck
objects.description: olive-grey 6-wheel military truck (cab at left facing the camera-left, three axles), with the raised launcher pod over its rear; parked on the dirt track, lower right of centre

bbox_px_frame0.note: including raised pod (top 648, right 1470); truck body without pod: x 1002-1437, y 836 (antenna) / 852 (cab roof) - 1034 (front wheel bottom)

body_extents_px.note: truck seen in 3/4 view from front-left; its length is foreshortened and not along the image x axis

objects.origin_guess_px: root not visible; bbox centre of body about (1220, 943), ground contact y about 1000-1034

objects.name: launcher_pod
objects.description: grey box raised at an angle over the truck's rear, 6 tube openings (2 rows x 3) facing up-left, with a rectangular handle frame above the openings
objects.long_axis: from tube face (~(1255, 725)) to the lower-right end (~(1450, 885)): about 250 px along the axis, tilted ~40 deg above horizontal in the image
objects.note: after the launch the upper-right tube is empty (persistent small change vs frame 0 at x 1063-1285, y 706-994 includes this and the flash-lit area)

objects.name: hill
objects.description: large sandy hill in the background, peak at about (930, 535), base spanning the whole image width at y ~600-665

objects.name: dirt_track
objects.description: pale pinkish dirt road under the truck, from bottom centre to the right edge (y ~905 at x=1920)

objects.name: rocks_and_mounds
objects.description: many small dark rocks/sand mounds on the slope (e.g. dark rock at (1637, 643), mounds at (625, 718), (380, 885)); a large dark shadow in the lower-left foreground (cast by something off-screen/terrain)

events.event: launch flash / first lighting change near the pod
missile nose first visible outside the tube (motion start, release begins)
events.reliability: +-1 frame; extrapolating the nose displacement back to zero speed gives motion start around frame 1-2

events.event: missile tail clears the tube mouth (fully out / release complete)
events.reliability: +-1 frame (tail at s=-427 vs mouth s=-449 at f13; at f12 still in tube)

events.event: missile passes above the hill ridge line (sky background)
missile nose reaches top image edge

events.reliability: last visible frame 33 (only the tail end)

events.note: missile accelerates throughout (image speed of centre ~6 px/frame at f3-4, ~30 at f16, ~61 at f30, ~65 at f32); no bounce, no direction change; straight image path
